items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: Like Old Man Joe White who played the drums. I played with him at a place called the Rotisserie

ctx.x: And Coot Davis...was a fantastic blues piano player. Just fantastic. In fact... You know what I mean when you say "roll" on the piano, how to get the tremolo, really... He could tremolo on that piano stronger than anybody I've ever heard in my life. I mean, he could make that piano just roll. I have never seen anybody or heard anybody before or since who could make that piano like he could make it... Just roll, you know. It was fantastic!
